record.question: A medicine that kills pests.
record.explanation: Answer C: Pesticide. Pesticide is the broad term for a substance that kills pests (C). Independent check: A pesticide is a substance used to kill or control pests; insecticide is narrower and applies to insects. Reference: https://www.epa.gov/minimum-risk-pesticides/what-pesticide. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
